gloss: and so on; etc.; and the like (formal)

definitions.gloss: and so on; etc.; and the like
definitions.explanation: Follows a noun or a list to show that similar items are included as well. A formal written suffix, typical of official documents, laws, notices and news.

examples.japanese: ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧{等|とう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧。
examples.english: To submit the documents and so on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住所|じゅうしょ}→住所：01430_juusho⟧、⟦{氏名|しめい}→氏名：04033_shimei⟧{等|とう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{記入|きにゅう}→記入：02624_kinyuu⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please fill in your address, name, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧{等|とう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{災害|さいがい}→災害：09636_saigai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{備|そな}えて→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧、⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{避難所|ひなんじょ}→避難所：07374_hinanjo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{場所|ばしょ}→場所：00829_basho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{知|し}らせている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: To prepare for disasters such as typhoons, the city tells residents where the evacuation shelters are.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
The character {等|とう} can also be read ⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧, with the same meaning: {本|ほん}や⟦{雑誌|ざっし}→雑誌：00686_zasshi⟧{等|など}. Official and legal writing reads it とう; in other texts either reading is possible, and many writers use the kana ⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧ to avoid the doubt.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- A、B{等|とう}: A, B and so on
- A{等|とう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧B: B such as A
- {等々|とうとう}: and so on and so forth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ~⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧: and so on, such as — the everyday word, used in speech and writing alike
